name: Wang An-kuo
bio: Wang An-kuo (王安國; Wang Anguo; 1028–1074) was a writer of ci, the Chinese song lyrics composed to set tunes, in the Song dynasty. He was a younger brother of the statesman and poet Wang An-shih.
The single ci here is from the chinese-poetry dataset of Zhu Zumou's 1924 anthology Three Hundred Song Lyrics (宋词三百首), in simplified characters, with the tune name as title.

poems.title: 清平乐 (Qing ping yue)
poems.author: Wang An-kuo
poems.collection: 宋詞三百首 (Three Hundred Song Lyrics)
poems.text:
留春不住。
费尽莺儿语。
满地残红宫锦污。
昨夜南园风雨。
小怜初上琵琶。
晓来思绕天涯。
不肯画堂朱户，春风自在梨花。
